description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing mappings between financial activities and ledger accounts in the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints for retrieving templates, listing all mappings, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting individual mappings related to financial activities and GL accounts.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class handling CRUD operations for financial activity to account mappings within Fineract.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template for creating new financial activity-account mappings.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all existing financial activity to account mappings.

methods.name: retreive
methods.description: Retrieves a specific financial activity to account mapping by its ID, with optional template details.

methods.name: createGLAccount
methods.description: Creates a new financial activity to account mapping based on provided request data.

methods.name: updateGLAccount
methods.description: Updates an existing financial activity to account mapping specified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteGLAccount
methods.description: Deletes a specific financial activity to account mapping identified by its ID.
